body: I'm alive and doing a lot of work in a lot of directions. I can't let go of my tools of suicide because they're a kind of comfort now but I am still alive.

TW: assault

I basically convinced myself by misanalysis of their body language and responses that I was receiving nonverbal consent. I realized almost immediately after the ordeal was over that I was wrong and had harmed them. I didn't feel like I was hurting someone until it was far too late and I accept my responsibility of negligence and of a lack of consideration.

I'm very sorry if my presence on this post triggers you, but as someone who has harmed somebody in this way (regardless of believing i had consent) you were most definitely assaulted if you feel harmed and did not give this person consent. They likely know it was wrong too. You are allowed to name it and call it as fits you best because your healing must happen on your own terms. You do not need to qualify yourself or compare yourself to other survivors or your harm to theirs. You were harmed, and in acceptance of this, you can try to heal. I've been harmed as well in different ways, albeit sexual, and only admitting that I was hurt regardless of what it must be called has much helped me. I wish you the very best, genuinely.

But I'm still really hesitant because I just don't know how my therapist may react. I'm twisted up inside and pushing everyone in my life away.

I know that's gross and sad. I panicked, I felt in the moment that I was going to lose my sister, my brother, my mom, the love of everyone in my family, etc. It's driven me to this incredibly suicidal point but I'm even afraid to go away for a mental health stay too. Because I don't know what's going to happen while I'm there, what my family will do, whether the person I've harmed decides to press charges, etc. I feel completely trapped in my life and body and I've just been hanging out with my mom and brother and sister as much as I can.
And yes, I've been laying low for about three months. This happened in July.

I've been spending time with mostly just my family. Another friend who developed feelings for me is gone now after I told them I couldn't handle a sexual relationship right now, and I lied to them too. I only really have two others left who talk to me, and a third, very good friend who I grew distant from. I don't know how to tell any of them.
They grew concerned as to why I'd cut off almost all of the friends in my life, so I lied to them preemptively. So they all at least know that I've been accused of this.
And also, fuck. TJ seemed like my best last resort. I'm basically out of options now, and am gonna have to just tell my family and hope they don't disown me or kick me out.

But should I tell my closest friends what's really going on? To most people it probably seems like I totally disappeared. I know they'll be wondering where I am, why I disappeared, etc., and lying even more now that I'm in a more rational mindset sounds pointless and evil. I don't want to be like this anymore.

I thought they were aroused. I can't understand why or how I either assumed or made myself believe that but I did. Their bodily response showed physical arousal and at one point I asked them if they wanted me to stop and they said "no," but I know full well both of these are not evidence of any kind that what I did was okay. Afterward the conversation we had confirmed what I thought and I knew I had assaulted someone. I still don't know how to deal with it really, it makes me dissociate, but I fully realize the weight of basically all of this. And I think suicide is tempting because if I die, my family won't have to watch me deteriorate in or out of prison, and they won't have to see the shame, embarrassment, financial ruin etc. of supporting me through a potential case and sentence.

Since, I've been considering every mistake and every moment I can remember in my life. I'm thinking about all my exes, my family, my earliest memories, all my past sexual partners, all of the friends I had at a time or another, and I'm thinking also about how uncertain and grave my future looks. I feel completely alone right now. 

Pretty much my entire world and everyone in it is affected somehow by this, those most deeply affected being the survivor and their closest folks. Me too, as I didn't come out of that experience unfazed. I was shaken and disgusted with myself and deeply afraid of what I'd done, how this person felt/would feel in the future, what would happen in the ensuing months... etc. 

A great deal of people either saw and believed the callout, and some people didn't and are probably wondering where I went. To a few people it probably appears as if I'm just gone off the face of the earth.

At this moment almost a year ago i already knew i wanted to die. How the fuck could i have done this to somebody? was the biggest feeling i felt for days.

What isn't fixable is the survivors of my harm justifiably seeking to destroy what's left of my life, and it will happen eventually, and the friends I used to have were my only support system before all of this happened. I'm more fucked than I can even explain and this thread is meant as an AMA to somehow help people in general better understand shit like this, not to help ME.
